Name: Bose Wired Earphones
Details: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds - in-Ear Headphones, USB-C Connection, Included Carry Case, in-Line Remote and Microphone, Black
product: Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds (USB-C, in-line remote and mic, carry case), Black, model 906940-0010
assumption: Delivery postcode '78' isn't a valid 4-digit AU postcode, so delivery costs are unconfirmed. I assumed the current Black model (RRP about $169.95), not an older 3.5mm Bose model. I could not check Amazon AU, OzBargain or Bose AU prices, and the search returned no Amazon AU listing.

best.why: JB Hi-Fi lists Black at $169, shown on StaticICE (updated 3 Nov 2026) and in a search snippet. Stock status and delivery cost for your location are unconfirmed. Free click & collect is likely but I did not check.

offers.notes: Black. StaticICE lists it for all states, updated 03-11-2026. The Dewdrop Mint colour shows as unavailable, and I did not see Black's stock status.
The Black listing exists but the snippet showed no price. The $169 is assumed to match RRP/JB, so it is unverified. The Good Guys price-matches.

This is the White variant, not Black. It was listed at $168 as a pre-order, with availability from 15 Oct 2026. I did not confirm the current status, and I did not find a Black listing at Harvey Norman.

tips: Prices are essentially at RRP ($169 to $169.95) and the product is new, so there are few discounts. Ask JB Hi-Fi, The Good Guys or Harvey Norman to price match if one of them gets a lower price.
Check OzBargain and cashback sites (ShopBack, Cashrewards) before buying. Black Friday sales start later this month and may bring the first discounts.
The earbuds need a USB-C device to work, as they have no battery and no 3.5mm or Lightning connection.
Please give a valid 4-digit postcode so delivery can be checked.
